summary: States the problem and requirements for hiding precise location in the emergency calling architecture, where networks give devices location so a call can be routed to the right emergency center. Sometimes the location should not be revealed to every party in the path. It is informational.

eli5.summary: When asking for help, you may need to say where you are, but you may not want every helper along the way to know your exact spot. This discusses how to share just enough.
